name: Fill Placeholders
description: Fill a template opened with Open Workbook from an object: every cell holding {{customer.name}}, {{invoice.number}} or {{date}} takes the value, on every sheet, keeping the cell's style and number format — so the layout is edited in Excel and the flow never names an address. A placeholder whose first name the object does not have is left as it is (the {{item.…}} row stays for Fill Table); a known name with a missing part becomes empty.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const whole = new RegExp('^\\\\s*\\\\{\\\\{\\\\s*([\\\\w.]+)\\\\s*\\\\}\\\\}\\\\s*$'); const any = new RegExp('\\\\{\\\\{\\\\s*([\\\\w.]+)\\\\s*\\\\}\\\\}', 'g'); const has = (k) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(values || {}, k.split('.')[0]); const get = (k) => k.split('.').reduce((o, p) => (o == null ? undefined : o[p]), values); const open = '{' + '{'; workbook.eachSheet((ws) => ws.eachRow({ includeEmpty: false }, (row) => row.eachCell({ includeEmpty: false }, (cell) => { const v = cell.value; const text = typeof v === 'string' ? v : v && typeof v === 'object' && Array.isArray(v.richText) ? v.richText.map((t) => t.text).join('') : null; if (text == null || text.indexOf(open) < 0) return; const m = text.match(whole); if (m) { if (!has(m[1])) return; const val = get(m[1]); cell.value = val == null ? '' : val; return; } cell.value = text.replace(any, (s, k) => { if (!has(k)) return s; const val = get(k); return val == null ? '' : String(val); }); }))); return workbook; })() }}"}]
